changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Global list of stock segments, shaped like finances.stock_types (issue #344)
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE finances.stock_segments ( id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, external_id UUID NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() UNIQUE, name TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT stock_segments_name_key UNIQUE (name) );

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: The segment is optional, so existing holdings stay without one

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX finances.idx_stock_holdings_stock_segment_id; ALTER TABLE finances.stock_holdings DROP COLUMN stock_segment_id;

changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment: Expose segment_label through both views. CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW only accepts columns appended at the end, so segment_label trails frozen in each UNION branch. The report view aggregates it instead of grouping by it, so same-ticker holdings keep merging into one row even when they disagree on the segment.
